title: Branch Storage Worksheet: Billable Days, Started Weeks and the Storage Fee
content:
The storage fee on Factory Production Orders for delivered units held at the branch warehouse is fixed by three quantities.

**Storage count.** The storage count runs over the calendar days from the day after the branch delivery date up to and including the day before the installation start date, or up to and including the handling date while installation has not started.

**Billable days.** The billable days are those calendar days less the class free storage days and less 7 calendar days for each installation reschedule initiated by the company or by weather on the order's installation job, never below zero.

**Storage fee.** The storage fee is the class storage fee per unit per week times the units on the order times the billable days counted in started seven-day weeks, never more than the class cap per order, rounded to the cent.

## Inputs

| Input | Source |
|---|---|
| branch delivery date, units on the order | the factory order record |
| installation start date; reschedules and who initiated them | the Installation Jobs record of the order's installation job |
| free storage days, storage fee per unit per week, cap per order | the order's build class |

## Worked example (hypothetical Custom Size Build order of 10 units)

- Delivered to the branch on 1 June; installation started on 20 July. The count runs from 2 June through 19 July: 29 days in June and 19 in July, 48 calendar days.
- Less the 30 free days leaves 18; one reschedule initiated by the company takes off 7 more: 11 billable days.
- 11 billable days are 2 started weeks. The fee is 6.00 for each of 10 units for 2 weeks, 120.00, under the 300.00 cap.

## Points of reading

- A reschedule initiated by the customer takes nothing off.
- The day installation starts is not counted.
- Billable days that come out below zero are taken as zero, and no fee results.
